name: Smart-Copy Connector
author: smartcopy

sections.description:
Smart-Copy Connector brings the Smart-Copy.ai content platform into your WordPress admin:

  • Order texts from wp-admin — pick a topic, type (article, blog post, product description and more), length, language, SEO keywords and links, and Smart-Copy researches live web (and academic) sources, writes the text section by section and generates an AI featured image.
  • Automatic publishing — finished texts are published on your site automatically: immediately, as drafts, or scheduled for a date you choose.
  • Autoblog — the plugin auto-detects your site’s topic (title, tagline, categories, existing posts), Smart-Copy plans a 20-topic content cluster with competitor research and publishes texts at your chosen weekly pace.
  • Firewall-proof delivery — texts are delivered by a pull mechanism (your site checks in every 5 minutes), so it works even on shared hostings that block incoming cloud traffic.
  • Bilingual interface — the plugin follows your WordPress language (English/Polish) and shows prices in USD or PLN accordingly.

A Smart-Copy.ai account is required. Each ordered text is billed from your Smart-Copy account balance; failed generations are refunded automatically.

External services

This plugin connects to the Smart-Copy.ai API (https://www.smart-copy.ai) — it is required for every feature of the plugin (ordering texts, delivering finished content, account balance, Autoblog).

Data sent to Smart-Copy.ai:

  • your site’s connection key (generated by this plugin) — with every request, to authenticate the site;
  • order details you type into the form (topic, length, guidelines, SEO keywords/links, source URLs);
  • a public site profile (site title, tagline, category names, recent post titles and short excerpts) — sent during periodic check-ins and when launching autoblogging, so Smart-Copy can detect your site’s topic;
  • exchange-rate and balance requests tied to your Smart-Copy account.

This data is sent only to Smart-Copy.ai and is covered by the Smart-Copy Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. No data is sent anywhere without the plugin being connected to a Smart-Copy account.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings → Smart-Copy and copy the connection key.
  3. In your Smart-Copy.ai dashboard, add your site (Connect a site → plugin method) and paste the key.
  4. A new Smart-Copy menu appears in wp-admin — order your first text or launch autoblogging.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Smart-Copy.ai account?

Yes. Texts are generated and billed by Smart-Copy.ai; the plugin is the bridge between your site and your account.

How much does a text cost?

Pricing is per 1000 characters (see current pricing at smart-copy.ai). The plugin always shows the price before you order, and failed generations are refunded automatically.

My hosting blocks incoming connections — will publishing work?

Yes. The plugin uses a pull mechanism: your site checks Smart-Copy for finished texts every 5 minutes over an outgoing connection, which shared hostings do not block.

What happens when I uninstall the plugin?

The plugin removes its options and scheduled tasks. Published posts stay untouched. Your Smart-Copy account and its balance are not affected.
sections.changelog:
2.6.3

  • Compatibility: tested up to WordPress 7.1.

2.6.2

  • Internal: JavaScript helpers on the admin screens use a plugin-specific prefix (no functional change).

2.6.1

  • Product descriptions: you can now write the main description and the short description in one go — tick one or both, each with its own length.
  • Volume discount on product descriptions ordered together (25+ products −25%, 100+ −45%, 500+ −60%, 2000+ −70%) — the same tiers as in the Smart-Copy dashboard; the estimate on the Product descriptions screen shows it before you confirm.
  • Translations are handled by translate.wordpress.org.

2.6.0

  • WooCommerce: existing product photos (featured image and gallery) are sent along with the order, so the generated description can mention what is actually visible — shape, material, finish.

2.5.0

  • Text types are now filtered by where the text goes: blog-post types for posts, shop types for product descriptions. Formats that are not WordPress content (social posts, marketing e-mails) stay in the dashboard and API.
  • Own featured image: when the AI image is switched off you can pick an image from the WordPress media library instead.
  • WooCommerce: you can also set a product image for products that do not have one yet (existing photos are never touched).
  • The autoblog and order form now use the same names for the same text types.
  • Added a discreet link to the guide explaining how the plugin works.

2.4.0

  • WooCommerce: generated text can now be written into a product description (main or short) instead of creating a blog post.
  • New screen “Product descriptions”: pick many products at once, see which ones lack a description, set the length once and order the whole batch — with the cost shown before you confirm.
  • Product photos are never overwritten — a generated image is only set when the product has no thumbnail yet.
  • The leading H1 is stripped from product descriptions (the product name already opens the page).

2.3.0

  • WordPress.org directory release: full gettext internationalisation (English/Polish), readme, uninstall cleanup.

2.2.0

  • Autoblog auto-detects the site’s topic (title, tagline, categories, recent posts).
  • Bilingual UI following the WordPress site language; prices in USD/PLN.

2.1.0

  • Full order form (9 text types, custom length, research source modes, SEO links, own source URLs).
  • Autoblog section in wp-admin (launch, pause, resume).

2.0.0

  • Order texts directly from wp-admin via the Smart-Copy public API; account balance and recent texts list.

1.2.0

  • Scheduled publishing (future posts with a date).

1.1.0

  • Pull delivery mode for hostings that block incoming cloud traffic.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: connection key, automatic publishing with featured images.
